name: Co-branding agreement profile
text: A co-branding agreement governs shared branding, marks, co-branded sites, advertising, services, launch dates, and related responsibilities. Look for title, named parties, effective date, branding rights, service obligations, payment terms, termination provisions, and signature evidence.
guidance: Use the source text as authority. Mark payment, obligations, and signatures not applicable when the document section does not support them; request human confirmation for uncertain contract type.

name: Affiliate agreement profile
text: An affiliate agreement governs relationships between an affiliate and another party, including rights, services, commissions, referrals, obligations, payment terms, term, termination, and signatures. Look for title, parties, effective date, commercial terms, obligations, termination, and signature evidence.
guidance: Do not infer commissions, dates, or signatures. Quote source evidence and classify absent fields as missing or not applicable.

name: Contract amendment profile
text: An amendment changes an existing agreement. Look for the amended agreement reference, parties, affected sections, changed wording, effective date, execution date, and signatures. Preserve the original agreement reference when visible.
guidance: Separate amendment text from definitions or unchanged provisions. Require human confirmation when the parent agreement or affected clause cannot be identified.

name: Agency agreement profile
text: An agency agreement appoints an agent to act for a principal. Look for appointment, authority, territory, services, compensation or commission, exclusivity, reporting, term, termination, and party roles.
guidance: Distinguish principal and agent roles from generic party mentions; do not infer commission amounts without source evidence.

name: Copyright license agreement profile
text: A copyright license grants rights to reproduce, distribute, display, perform, or create derivative works. Look for work identification, grant scope, territory, media, exclusivity, royalties, restrictions, term, termination, and ownership.
guidance: Capture each granted right and restriction separately; distinguish ownership from the license grant.

name: Development agreement profile
text: A development agreement governs creation of software, products, or services. Look for specifications, milestones, acceptance, delivery, ownership, intellectual property, fees, warranties, support, change control, and termination.
guidance: Extract milestones and acceptance obligations only when the responsible party and timing are supported by the source.

name: Distribution agreement profile
text: A distribution agreement governs supply and resale through a distributor. Look for products, territory, channels, exclusivity, orders, forecasts, pricing, delivery, inventory, compliance, term, and termination.
guidance: Separate supplier and distributor responsibilities and preserve territory/channel restrictions.

name: Endorsement agreement profile
text: An endorsement agreement governs a person or organization promoting a product or service. Look for endorsed subject, deliverables, appearances, usage rights, compensation, morality clauses, exclusivity, term, and termination.
guidance: Distinguish the endorser from the sponsoring company and capture usage restrictions with source evidence.

name: Franchise agreement profile
text: A franchise agreement grants a franchisee rights to operate using a franchisor brand and system. Look for territory, fees, royalties, standards, training, intellectual property, reporting, renewal, default, and termination.
guidance: Separate initial fees, recurring royalties, territory, operating standards, and termination conditions.

name: Hosting agreement profile
text: A hosting agreement governs provision of infrastructure or application hosting. Look for service levels, uptime, support, security, data handling, fees, backups, access, service credits, term, and termination.
guidance: Extract measurable service levels and remedies separately; do not invent uptime values.

name: Intellectual property agreement profile
text: An intellectual property agreement governs ownership, assignment, licensing, protection, prosecution, enforcement, or use of intellectual property. Look for covered rights, ownership, license scope, registrations, confidentiality, and remedies.
guidance: Distinguish assignment, license, ownership reservation, and enforcement rights.

name: Joint venture agreement profile
text: A joint venture agreement establishes a shared business undertaking. Look for purpose, contributions, ownership, governance, voting, profit sharing, funding, reserved matters, deadlock, transfer, and dissolution.
guidance: Identify the venture entity or arrangement and distinguish contribution obligations from governance rights.

name: License agreement profile
text: A license agreement grants permission to use property, technology, content, marks, data, or intellectual property. Look for licensed subject, grant, restrictions, territory, field of use, fees, royalties, term, termination, and ownership.
guidance: Capture the exact scope and restrictions of the license; do not confuse a license with an ownership transfer.

name: Maintenance agreement profile
text: A maintenance agreement governs ongoing maintenance, support, repair, or updates. Look for covered systems, response times, service levels, exclusions, fees, renewals, and termination.
guidance: Extract support windows, response commitments, and renewal terms only when explicitly stated.

name: Marketing agreement profile
text: A marketing agreement governs campaigns, promotion, advertising services, deliverables, approvals, brand use, media, fees, reporting, and performance obligations.
guidance: Separate campaign deliverables from performance metrics and payment terms.

name: Non-compete and non-solicit agreement profile
text: A non-compete or non-solicit agreement restricts competitive activity or solicitation. Look for restricted activities, people, customers, geography, duration, exceptions, consideration, and remedies.
guidance: Record the precise restriction, geography, duration, and affected relationships; do not infer enforceability.

name: Outsourcing agreement profile
text: An outsourcing agreement transfers operational services to a provider. Look for scope, service levels, transition, personnel, data/security, fees, governance, audit, business continuity, exit assistance, and termination.
guidance: Separate provider deliverables, customer dependencies, service levels, and transition obligations.

name: Promotion agreement profile
text: A promotion agreement governs promotional activity, campaigns, prizes, events, media, brand use, deliverables, approvals, compensation, and compliance.
guidance: Check for advertising-law, contest, approval, and usage restrictions without inferring regulatory conclusions.

name: Reseller agreement profile
text: A reseller agreement permits resale of products or services. Look for authorization, territory, channels, pricing, orders, support, customer obligations, trademarks, restrictions, term, and termination.
guidance: Distinguish reseller rights from end-customer terms and preserve pricing/territory evidence.

name: Service agreement profile
text: A service agreement governs delivery of professional or operational services. Look for scope, deliverables, milestones, acceptance, service levels, fees, expenses, confidentiality, intellectual property, and termination.
guidance: Extract concrete deliverables and timing; do not promote vague aspirations to obligations without accountable parties.

name: Sponsorship agreement profile
text: A sponsorship agreement exchanges sponsorship rights, promotion, branding, event access, benefits, fees, exclusivity, deliverables, approvals, and termination rights.
guidance: Identify sponsor and rights holder roles and separate sponsorship rights from benefits and fees.

name: Strategic alliance agreement profile
text: A strategic alliance agreement coordinates collaboration between organizations. Look for purpose, workstreams, contributions, governance, intellectual property, confidentiality, announcements, economics, term, and exit.
guidance: Do not infer a partnership or joint venture unless the source establishes one.

name: Supply agreement profile
text: A supply agreement governs purchase and delivery of goods. Look for products, specifications, forecasts, orders, pricing, delivery, acceptance, quality, warranties, inventory, shortages, and termination.
guidance: Separate supplier obligations, buyer commitments, delivery terms, and quality remedies.

name: Transportation agreement profile
text: A transportation agreement governs carriage or logistics services. Look for goods, routes, carriers, delivery, rates, fuel, insurance, loss, claims, compliance, service levels, and termination.
guidance: Capture delivery and liability terms only from explicit source language.

name: Confidentiality agreement profile
text: A confidentiality or nondisclosure agreement protects confidential information. Look for definitions, exclusions, permitted use, disclosure controls, return or destruction, duration, compelled disclosure, and remedies.
guidance: Distinguish confidentiality duration from agreement duration and preserve exclusions.

name: Purchase agreement profile
text: A purchase agreement governs acquisition of goods, assets, or a business. Look for subject, price, payment, conditions, representations, warranties, closing, indemnity, and termination.
guidance: Do not infer closing dates, consideration, or representations not stated in the source.

name: Employment agreement profile
text: An employment agreement governs an individual's employment. Look for role, compensation, benefits, duties, term, termination, confidentiality, intellectual property, restrictive covenants, and governing law.
guidance: Protect personal data and distinguish employee obligations from employer obligations.
